messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The technical sheet requires IGEA to make available to the verifier, for devices more than 20 years old, the certification of structural verification of the residual life cycles. As of 14 November 2026, for which of the seven truck-mounted cranes (positions 1-7) does this apply?

response.text: For which of the seven truck-mounted cranes (positions 1-7) does the requirement apply, as of 14 November 2026, that IGEA must provide the verifier with the certification of structural verification of the residual life cycles, given that the technical sheet imposes this for devices more than 20 years old?
